maria-chen: Hey folks — opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 — fixes a KV cache eviction edgecase and adds a small integration test. PTAL when you have a sec. I addressed yesterday's nits and added the test @kevin-b. Unit jobs are green; GPU matrix is flaky right now.

kevin-b: Quick Q — does the new test exercise the case where the prefix KV cache rotates mid-sequence? I couldn't tell from the diff.

maria-chen: Good question. I added a specific scenario `kv_rotation_midseq` in tests/integration/kv_cache_test.py to simulate rotation during generation. Example snippet: ```python
def test_kv_rotation_midseq():
    # warm KV with long prompt, then force rotation and continue generation
    assert outputs_consistent()
```
I also added a small retry wrapper around the GPU matrix job to cut down flakiness. Commit: abc1234.

jason: Left one tiny comment about the logger level — prefer `debug` over `info` for that loop. Otherwise LGTM. Can someone own the canary timing? We should avoid starting a heavy canary in peak hours.

olivia: I can take the canary window. Can we schedule it after 8pm PT? Also CI shows one flaky in `test_gpt_parallel` on the GPU run — likely unrelated but flagging.

ci-bot: [build-status] runtime/pr/482 — unit: passed, integration: passed, gpu: failed (flake) — re-run suggested.

maria-chen: Re-ran the GPU job and pushed a small fix for the logging nit; squashed commits. PTAL @kevin-b @jason. If the GPU job goes green I'll merge and start the canary off-hours.

kevin-b: PTAL — looked through the added test and the fix. Approving this one. ✅

jason: LGTM, thanks Maria. :shipit:

olivia: Got it — scheduling canary for 8:30pm PT and I'll monitor for 2hrs. If anything suspicious, I'll roll back and post here.
